name: Seldsienean
sum: Seldsienean is a teleosauroid thalattosuchian from the Middle Jurassic of England and France.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Specimens from the Pierre de Caen, Great Oolite and Forest Marble.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
